PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build lean muscle mass"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation (Hypertrophy Focus)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push/Horizontal":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell bench press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline dumbbell press 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated dumbbell shoulder press 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          cable chest fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          triceps rope pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower Heavy":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell back squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          standing calf raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Pull":
        warmup:
          ski erg 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell bent-over row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          pull-up (assisted or bodyweight) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single-arm dumbbell row 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell biceps curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Hypertrophy & Core":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          glute bridge (barbell) 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking lunges 3x12..16 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated leg curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hanging leg raise 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
